{{Attr|Aggro}} (Variable) }} ==Description== The '''Null Dredge''' was a tanky enemy that appears in [[Outpost 16]], [[Banlands]] and [[Blind Faith]] as part of the [[Null & Void Event]]. It was slower than every enemy that appeared before it, but also has significantly higher health than them. ==Logbook Description== "''A Null Dredge is a slow, lazy enemy. They are heavy in size but quite shy, so they choose to hide their face using a bag. Despite their massive body, Null Dredges prefer to avoid fighting and will wander through the [[Nil Zone]] at their own pace. However, their temper is short, and any little disturbance will send them into a rampage.''" ==Appearance== The '''Null Dredge''' is a large, purple entity. It wears brown cloth around its waist, a brown belt, a rope around its right arm and a grey spiked armband. As it is shy, it wears a bag which covers most of its head except a single yellow eye. It also has a few purple tendrils and a brown bandolier on its body. In its right hand, it holds a metal club with multiple spikes. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Outpost 16]], [[Banlands]] and [[Blind Faith]] is listed instead. *The '''Null Dredge''' has higher health than the enemies that appear before it, though most options that worked before are still effective against them. **Single target towers like the [[Golden Scout]], [[Militant]] or [[Cowboy]] can be used. **AOE towers like the [[Toxic Gunner]], [[Rocketeer]], [[Military Base]] or [[Mortar]] can clear these out quite well, as it generally spawns in hordes. *Later on, the '''Null Dredge''' becomes rather weak, meaning most towers should be capable of defeating them, including late-game towers like the [[Accelerator]], [[Pursuit]] or [[Golden Minigunner]]. *Defense dropping towers like the [[Pyromancer]], [[Electroshocker]] or [[Toxic Gunner]] can be used to reduce its defense, though this is generally not necessary as it is quite low. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseNullDredge1.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, first animation variant (18 October 2025 – Present) CorpseNullDredge2.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, second animation variant (18 October 2025 – Present) CorpseNullDredge3.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, third animation variant (18 October 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Tower Defense Simulator - Halloween 2025 Trailer|'''Null Dredge''' on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} DefaultEnemyIconIG.png|'''Null Dredge''' on its bugged [[Index]] icon. NullDredgeIconIG.png|'''Null Dredge''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Null Dredge''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''18 October 2025''' - [[v1.77.0]] **'''Null Dredge''' added. **{{Bug}} '''Null Dredge''' has a broken icon. **{{Bug}} '''Null Dredge''' is positioned sideways in the [[Index]]. *''' 19 October 2025''' - [[v1.77.0|v1.77.3a]] **[[Logbooks|Logbook]] description added. *'''25 October 2025''' - [[v1.78.0]] **Now appears in [[Banlands]]. **{{Bugfix}} '''Null Dredge''' is now properly positioned in the [[Index]]. *'''31 October 2025''' - [[v1.79.0]] **Now appears in [[Blind Faith]]. **{{Bugfix}} '''Null Dredge''' now uses its correct icon. *'''26 November 2025''' - [[v1.80.0|v1.80.1e]] **'''Null Dredge''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''3 December 2025''' - [[v1.82.0]] **{{Bug}} Cannot be spawned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''4 December 2025''' - [[v1.82.0]]b **{{Bugfix}} Can now be spawned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. {{Outpost16|[[Nulling]] & [[Null Runner]]|Wave 1|Null Dredge|Wave 2|[[Null Scout]]|Wave 5}} {{Banlands|[[Nulling]]|Wave 2|Null Dredge|Wave 3|[[Null Scout]]|Wave 6 (Easy)|hardt3 = [[Null Shrieker]]|hardw3 = Wave 5 (Hard)}} {{BlindFaith|Start|N/A|[[Null Scout]] & Null Dredge|Wave 1|[[Null Runner]] & [[Lost Glitch]]|Wave 2}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
